status: M0 normative security contract; not implemented or OS-verified

localTransport.host: exact loopback literal and configured port; reject arbitrary Host and forwarded Host
localTransport.origin: exact paired HTTPS workbench Origin (scheme, hostname, port); no wildcard, null Origin or substring comparison
localTransport.cors: only the validated Origin; never sole authentication
localTransport.tokens: CSPRNG bearer tokens supplied only in Authorization headers; never URLs, persistent browser storage, logs or errors
localTransport.version: major mismatch or absent required capability rejects before operation
localTransport.request: reject unexpected content types and malformed JSON; body limits; mutation needs paired channel authentication

pairing.confirmation: local user sees exact workbench Origin, platform userId, deviceId and requested capabilities, then explicitly confirms
pairing.proof: pair code is not authorization; verify paired browser channel and platform identity separately
pairing.renewal: requires existing authenticated channel, valid platform identity and same binding; revocation invalidates tokens
pairing.unpair: atomically reject new operations and invalidate channel sessions; do not claim erasure of all existing local data

execution.permission: online platform check for object real project before every new execute or upload; previous check and UI role do not grant future permission
execution.http: only explicitly selected agent executor; never fallback silently
execution.stdio: absolute executable or OS-resolved explicit program plus string argument array; no implicit shell; absolute optional cwd; environment allowlist plus resolved named variables; not entire parent environment
execution.confirmation: first launch and any executable/args/cwd/environment-definition version change require local confirmation; compare canonical immutable configuration identity/version
execution.cancel: stop local waiting/process according to transport; never promise upstream rollback; terminal result not changed by late response
execution.restart: recover encrypted upload state or query operation status; never replay a Tool

secrets.vault: OS credential store holds master keys; encrypted data separate; unavailable vault reports explicit failure
secrets.browser: raw requests/responses and session MCP credentials remain memory-only; browser persistent queue redacted only
secrets.queue: authenticated encryption with unique nonce and identity/version associated data; atomic persistence; key never colocated in plaintext; exactly one uploader per Run
secrets.backup: off by default; explicitly selected personal platform-managed encryption, not end-to-end encryption
secrets.diagnostics: no secrets in URL, logs, Toast, diagnostics or audit; source labels only

reservedOperations.purpose: consume one-time challenge after local confirmation
launch once after online authority check and explicit configuration confirmation

evidenceRequired: HTTPS Chrome and Edge recent two stable majors to loopback on macOS Windows Linux
Host/Origin spoof, expired and replayed challenge, wrong identity
local confirmation denial, config changes and no shell/env inheritance
vault unavailable, encrypted queue restart and no Tool replay
permission revoked between run completion and upload
notClaimed: tokens encryption or key rotation implemented
